quarterly_data.signal: Wistron investor deck (Citi conference, 06-04-2026): 1Q26 realized gross profit NT$44,094 million, a 5.21% gross margin (4Q25: 5.62%; 1Q25: 7.81%), operating margin 3.44%. Inventory reached NT$611,556 million at 2026-03-31 (2025-12-31: NT$355,474 million) and accounts receivable NT$567,862 million. Full-year 2025: net revenue NT$2,186,523 million, operating income NT$78,553 million, PAT NT$27,408 million, EPS 9.04. Non-consumer products are about 80% of revenue in the current 'Wistron 3.0' phase (about 50% in 2011-2022), with AI servers and networking as the theme of the cycle.
